title: Research: exhibit a literal P112 rank-4,5,6,6 counterexample
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR3418: conditional four-piece exclusion at ranks 3,5,6,6
- first-piece rank four left open
+ literal ranks 4,5,6,6 counterexample over every characteristic-zero field
+ disjoint support sizes 6,12,20,18; code intersection exactly one
```

Four signed integer pieces sum to the 56-site frame-normal codeword with normal `(0,0,0,0,0,0,2,-2)/4`. Every site, label, coefficient and binary basis is in `research/p112-four-piece-rank4/WITNESS.json`. An explicit joint-rank minor has determinant `-512`.

This settles [PR3418's open rank-four question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3418). The new witness needs no Weyl-chamber premise, predecessor theorem or unmerged object. PR3418's conditional rank-three exclusion is contextual credit; combined under its stated premise, the first-rank boundary is three versus four. The new package alone proves the explicit counterexample and one-dimensional intersection.

The original `complex-rank-shape-decoder` card is explicitly narrowed to this representation boundary. No full C5, actual caller, decoder, physical invoice, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier update is claimed. The next question needs a literal caller's required quotient and intersection dimension. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19009356).

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3418 for the exact question and prior boundary, PR3397/3405, PR3161/3162 and root-simplex geometry, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112 lineage. Exact contextual heads and canonical input pins are separate in CONTEXT.json and SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the attempted global rank-four exclusion fails on a removed-frame normal. Its discovery logs and unpublished failed draft are retained in session evidence. The published acceptance depends only on the literal witness.
  **After:** all 112 coefficient identities, binary support ranks 4,5,6,6 and rational ranks 8,4,11 pass. The separate implementation uses direct literal rows, its own root reconstruction, low-pivot binary elimination, a full rational row basis and Bareiss determinant `-512`.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized Python 3.15 checks, one actual optimized CLI acceptance and seven rejecting mutants, eight unit mutants, strict Ruff 0.17.1 diagnostics and formatting pass.
- Exact committed-byte/history checks and all three actual optimized read-only Git-free export commands pass at `a27db1d68fe0391e636e82cbd8c0185549daa0df`. All 15 source/input hashes remain unchanged. Canonical submission refresh remains `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision six. Live overlap covers 341 open PRs and 2,270 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; it is not proof of novelty.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-four-piece-rank4
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p112-four-piece-rank4/verify.py
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p112-four-piece-rank4/independent.py
python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p112-four-piece-rank4/test_controls.py
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-four-piece-rank4 --check-source-history
```

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay are unrun. The witness is not a higher-dimensional caller solution or a minimum-cardinality classification.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Only a new scoped research package is added. Frozen sources and the selected record are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** archive

Merging preserves the result for review; it does not admit a supplier or change the selected frontier.
